description: Padded turns build real history, then an explicit manual reset compaction runs. Passing requires canonical audit evidence of a manual/reset compaction that completed with a source_tail_reset_v1 checkpoint whose coverage actually advanced -- a checkpoint covering nothing would mean the reset discarded no history. The compact action in this Scenario is the request, never the proof.
